name: Sister Scheme 2
source:
Shiori has two older sisters, Amane and Misaki. People around him think he has a sister complex, so he decides to be remote and cold to them. But one day, he receives an email, "Send us a picture of you and your sisters kissing at school. If you don't, your secret will go public..." 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
诗织有两个姐姐，天音和美咲。周围的人都认为他有姐妹情结，所以他决定对他们保持距离和冷漠。但有一天，他收到一封电子邮件，“给我们发送一张你和你的姐妹在学校接吻的照片。如果你不这样做，你的秘密就会被公开……” 

[来自工口游戏商店]
